scripts.preinstall: node -e "const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'';if(ua&&!ua.startsWith('pnpm/')){process.stderr.write('ERROR: Please use pnpm to install dependencies.\n');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
